meta.method: Each supplied link was requested, redirects followed, and the destination page read. Values below are transcribed from what the destination page returned. Nothing was inferred.
meta.asin_definition_note: The Catalog Items reference defines the `asin` path parameter as 'The Amazon Standard Identification Number (ASIN) of the item.' Amazon does not publish the 10-character length in that reference; the length used as a check below comes from the observed working ASINs in this same register, and is flagged rather than asserted.
meta.price_policy_note: Program Policies section 2(b) permits showing price and availability only where Amazon serves the link carrying that data, or where it is obtained through the Creators API or PA API. No such feed is connected here, so no price, rating, review count or availability appears anywhere on this site.
meta.confirmation_note: confirmation_date is blank by design. It is the date the account owner confirms each Special Link's destination and tracking report inside the Associates dashboard. That is an in-account action this session cannot perform.
